reasoning: By the pigeonhole principle, placing 20 pigeons into 19 holes with at most one pigeon per hole is impossible. With 20 pigeons and only 19 holes, at least one hole would need to contain two pigeons, violating the constraint. Therefore the problem is unsatisfiable.
